title: Student Engagement Coordinator
description:
Overall, Purpose Scope:

The postholder will be a member of the Student Services team, supporting college attendance by monitoring and managing absences on college systems, taking appropriate action to ensure attendance data is accurately recorded. Monitoring notified absences daily and liaise with the wider Student Services team to ensure vulnerable and safeguarded learners are picked up swiftly. Ensuing the accuracy of reporting so that reports for curriculum and Student Services teams enable them to improve attendance. Dealing with attendance enquiries from parents and carers and learners, taking appropriate action and liaising with staff to improve learner attendance and ensuring effective communication and liaison with staff, in order that the service;

To provide effective operational administration of the College's attendance and punctuality processes through accurate monitoring, first-day absence procedures, attendance recording, reporting and communication with learners, parents/carers and staff. The postholder will play a key role in supporting student attendance, safeguarding and learner success.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Monitor absence information from college absence reporting systems throughout the day and ensure college systems are regularly updated.

Prioritise attendance monitoring and follow-up for identified vulnerable learners including those with EHCPs, care experience, safeguarding plans and other identified welfare concerns.

Monitor daily attendance patterns and identify emerging attendance concerns, escalating these appropriately to curriculum managers, tutors or safeguarding colleagues.

Ensure effective communication and liaison with curriculum teams and wider Student Services teams.

Contribute to absence reporting systems that are shared with curriculum teams so that tutors can take appropriate actions to improve attendance.

Ensure attendance coding and absence records are maintained in accordance with College procedures and audit requirements.

Take appropriate action where an absence could indicate a missing learner at risk and report concerns to the Safeguarding team to initiate further action.

Escalate attendance concerns that meet safeguarding thresholds immediately in accordance with College safeguarding procedures.

Recognise when patterns of absence may indicate welfare, wellbeing or safeguarding concerns and report these appropriately.

Make direct contact with learners to ascertain reasons for un-certified absences and liaise with parents/carers/ next of kin.

Support other members of the first day calls team to ensure that processes are completed in a timely manner.

Reflect the vision, mission and values of the College.

To positively promote and implement the College’s strategies on equality, diversity, safeguarding.

Undertake appropriate staff development activities that support personal development and the changing needs of the College and its environment.

Act as a central point of contact for attendance-related enquiries from learners, parents/carers and staff, ensuring timely and professional communication.

Maintain effective communication with curriculum teams, Student Services, Safeguarding and MIS to support attendance monitoring processes.

Support the administration of attendance-related bursary eligibility checks and communicate attendance information required for student financial support processes.

Undertake such other duties as may reasonably be required commensurate with this grade, across the college group campuses.

Person Specification

Essential

Qualifications

English and maths at a minimum of GCSE grade 4 or equivalent.

Good computer literacy

Skills and Experience

Essential

Experience of using spreadsheets, databases and inputting data

Experience of monitoring and review systems including filing and maintaining records

Experience in liaising with members of the public and problem solving

Experience of dealing with people at different levels of the organisation

Good digital literacy skills

An understanding of their responsibilities relating to the safeguarding of young people and vulnerable adults

Desirable

Experience in setting up computerised administrative systems

Work experience in a College environment

Attributes

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to develop positive working relationships at all levels (internally and externally to college) and to translate ideas into actions

Accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to self-manage, prioritise and work effectively under pressure

Able to work collaboratively within a team

Flexible approach to working

Demonstrate knowledge of and commitment to equality of opportunity and treatment for all members of the college community

An understanding and respect for confidentiality

This role is ideal for those wanting to further their career in education and who have a desire to secure the best outcomes for our young people with SEND.

For this role we are open to discussing the possibility of reduced hours, job share, compressed hours, or staggered hours. Please wait until the job offer stage before asking us about flexibility, and we will explore what’s possible for the role.

Are you an organised and proactive administrator with a passion for compliance, health and safety, and making a real difference?

Reach South Academy Trust is looking for a Health, Safety and Risk Co-ordinator to support the delivery of health, safety and risk management activities across our academies and central services. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and play a vital role in helping our schools remain safe, compliant and well-managed environments for pupils, staff and visitors.

About the role

Working closely with the Health, Safety and Risk Lead, you will provide administrative, operational and technical support across a wide range of health and safety functions. From coordinating audits and inspections to maintaining compliance records and supporting risk management processes, you will help ensure that our schools meet statutory requirements and Trust standards.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organisation, attention to detail and working collaboratively with a variety of stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintaining health, safety and risk management systems and records.
  • Monitoring action plans arising from audits, inspections and risk assessments.
  • Coordinating Trust-wide audit programmes and compliance visits.
  • Supporting incident reporting, investigations and action tracking.
  • Assisting with the administration of contractor compliance processes and documentation.
  • Coordinating health and safety training programmes and maintaining training records.
  • Producing reports, dashboards and management information to support decision-making.
  • Supporting schools with risk management, compliance monitoring and good practice.

    • About the successful candidate

    We are seeking a highly organised and motivated individual who can manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

    • Experience providing administrative support within health and safety, compliance, risk management or a similar environment.
    • Strong organisational and record-management skills.
    • Excellent IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams.
    • Experience monitoring actions, maintaining records and tracking compliance.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach.
    • The ability to work independently and collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders.

    Experience within education, estates, facilities management, construction, local government or a regulated environment would be advantageous. Knowledge of IOSH, NEBOSH, risk management systems or RIDDOR reporting requirements would also be beneficial.

    We are a family of schools working in partnership for the benefit of all our pupils and students. We believe our charitable aim, to advance education, is best achieved through collaboration, both within the Trust and beyond.

    We operate 21 academies across Devon, Cornwall, Dorset, Gloucestershire and Wiltshire, serving learners aged 3 to 19. Alongside our primary, all-through and technical provision, we are proud to include a strong and integral network of seven special schools and one alternative provision setting.

    These settings are a vital part of our community, providing inclusive, high-quality education for pupils with a wide range of needs, including complex learning profiles, autism, and social, emotional and mental health needs, as well as those who benefit from a more personalised approach. Together, we are committed to helping every young person thrive.

    Those we recruit are able to demonstrate that they share our values, are highly motivated to work with colleagues, within and beyond their school, to continuously develop their skills and pursue professional excellence.

    Next Steps

    If you think this role may be for you and want to be involved at this exciting time in our development and have any questions about the position, please get in touch by calling the Recruitment team on 07759365064 or emailing us at recruitment@reachsouth.org.

    Closing date: for applications is 6th December 2026

    Interview Date: Interviews are provisionally booked for week commencing 14th December 2026

    To apply for this opportunity, please complete our online application form by clicking ‘apply now’ on the advert.

    We reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to the closing date. Therefore, an early application is strongly advised.

    Opportunities and Benefits

    We offer a competitive salary plus LGPS pension, great career progression and development opportunities, access to our Employee Assistance Programme with many other benefits.

    We’re proud of how we support our staff in order that you have high levels of job satisfaction, are aware of the difference you are making for the children and families you work with and can see your contribution towards our community. There are regular opportunities for professional development and training, and a wider community of staff to network with within Reach South Multi Academy Trust. You will have the chance to visit other local schools, work alongside a range of outside professionals and take part in a variety of e-learning and face-to-face training.

    We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Each post is subject to an enhanced DBS check.

    Reach South Academy Trust has an Equal Opportunities Policy for selection and recruitment. Applicants are requested to complete the Equal Opportunities Monitoring section of the application form before submitting.

We are a high-achieving college who attract around 3,000 sixth form students across the region each year. We are based within the stunning New Forest National Park and offer our students a huge range of courses and superb facilities.

Responsibilities as our Progression Advisor will include:

  • applicants.

  • potential applicants and their families around the campus.

title: Attendance & Welfare Officer
description:
HOME VISITS AND WELFARE CHECKS

To deliver the academy's programme of home visits ensuring that:

- Home visits are prioritised and completed daily, in line with the academy's attendance procedures and the outcome of the morning's first-day response

- Every visit is planned, risk assessed and logged, following the academy's lone working procedures

- Visits are recorded accurately and promptly in the academy's systems, including who was seen, what was discussed and any concerns

- Where a child is not seen, or there are concerns about their welfare, this is escalated immediately to the Designated Safeguarding Lead

- Joint visits are undertaken with the safeguarding team, Attendance Manager or external partners where risk or need requires it

- Checks are carried out on students who may be missing education, working with the local authority's Children Missing Education team

CASEWORK WITH STUDENTS AND FAMILIES

- Hold a caseload of students with persistent absence, agreeing attendance support plans with clear targets and reviewing them regularly

- Identify the reasons for each student's absence through conversations with the student, family and staff, and put practical support in place

- Support students' return to school, including morning collection and accompanying students into school where this has been agreed, risk assessed and consented to by parents/carers, in line with Trust policy

- Work alongside Inclusion Mentors, the SEMH Provision Lead and the SENDCo to support students with emotionally based school avoidance through agreed return plans

- Signpost and refer families to other services, including Early Help, health, housing and parenting support

- Step students down to year team support when attendance improves, or refer them to the Attendance Manager when it does not

FORMAL PROCEDURES AND EVIDENCE

- Record visits and contacts to a standard that can be used as evidence in formal attendance procedures

- Support the Attendance Manager in preparing cases for Notices to Improve, penalty notices, prosecution and Education Supervision Orders, attending court where required

- Deliver formal letters and notices by hand where required

- Challenge unauthorised and condoned absence clearly and respectfully during visits

SAFEGUARDING AND MULTI-AGENCY WORKING

- Work under the guidance of the Designated Safeguarding Lead, attending regular safeguarding and vulnerable students meetings

- Maintain up to date knowledge of safeguarding legislation and guidance including Keeping Children Safe in Education, reporting all concerns promptly and appropriately

- Represent the academy at multi-agency meetings for students on caseload, including Early Help and Team Around the Family meetings

- Build effective working relationships with the local authority attendance service, Children Missing Education and Elective Home Education teams, social care and other partners

CONTRIBUTION TO THE ATTENDANCE TEAM AND COMMUNITY

- Support the morning late gate and first-day absence response alongside the Attendance Officer

- Contribute to weekly attendance meetings, sharing caseload progress

- Visit Year 6 families with attendance concerns before transition, working with primary schools

- Contribute to whole-school attendance initiatives, parent workshops and community events

title: Director, Sales - SLED
description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

 About Ping Identity:

 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

 The Role

 The Regional Director of Sales for SLED East will lead a team of Strategic Account Executives serving State, Local, Higher Education, and K–12 customers across the Eastern United States. This leader owns regional strategy, pipeline creation, forecast discipline, deal execution, partner activation, customer relationships, and team development to deliver profitable revenue growth and durable new-logo attainment for Ping Identity.

 The successful candidate is a customer-centered, outcomes-oriented sales leader who can translate identity security into mission value: modernizing legacy environments, enabling Zero Trust, strengthening identity assurance, protecting citizen and student services, securing workforce and third-party access, reducing fraud, and improving resilience across hybrid and cloud environments.

 Reports to: VP, Public Sector Sales
Location: Field-based; Eastern U.S. preferred
Travel: Regular travel across the territory and to customer, partner, and industry events; up to 50% as needed

 You Will

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Strategic Account Executives; set clear expectations for new-logo growth, pipeline creation, forecast accuracy, customer engagement, partner leverage, and deal execution.

• Create and execute the SLED East go-to-market strategy, including territory design, account segmentation, whitespace analysis, state-by-state priorities, coverage plans, and quarterly operating rhythms aligned to Ping Identity’s broader public-sector strategy.

• Build early-stage demand and new-logo pipeline before formal solicitations through executive outreach, mission-led account hypotheses, customer referrals, partner intelligence, associations, events, digital programs, and responsible use of AI and data signals.

• Position Ping Identity’s identity-security platform against SLED priorities such as legacy modernization, Zero Trust, identity proofing and assurance, phishing-resistant authentication, workforce and contractor access, citizen and constituent services, student and faculty access, fraud reduction, privacy, auditability, and operational resilience.

• Lead disciplined opportunity execution from discovery through award and expansion, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, technical validation, demonstrations, proofs of value, RFI/RFP responses, contract-vehicle strategy, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and close plans.

• Maintain an accurate, evidence-based forecast that reflects funding and budget authority, compelling events, decision criteria, stakeholder support, procurement route, contract vehicle, competitive position, partner role, implementation readiness, and timing risk.

• Build trusted relationships with state CIO, CISO, CTO, digital-service, security, identity, education, procurement, finance, program, and executive stakeholders. Expand relationship coverage beyond a single office or incumbent contact.

• Develop and activate a national and regional partner ecosystem, including contract holders, distributors, resellers, systems integrators, advisory firms, cloud and technology partners, higher-education and K–12 ecosystem partners, and public-sector associations. Establish joint account maps, pursuit plans, executive engagement, enablement, co-marketing, procurement paths, and partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline goals.

• Work with key national and regional partners and associations—including relevant cooperative purchasing and contract-vehicle communities, NASPO, E&I, NASCIO, NASTD, Carahsoft, and regional government-technology and education networks—to deepen customer relationships, create trusted introductions, shape demand, and expand reach into new logos.

• Orchestrate the cross-functional pursuit team across Sales Engineering, Solutions Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Business Value, Marketing, Channel, Product, Finance, Legal, and executive sponsors. Ensure one customer narrative, one account plan, and clear ownership of next actions.

• Coach the team on public-sector buying behavior, SLED budget cycles, cooperative purchasing, state and local contracting, education procurement, ethics and engagement boundaries, value selling, MEDDPPICC, mutual action plans, and close-plan discipline.

• Represent Ping Identity with credibility at customer briefings, executive roundtables, public-sector associations, partner events, and education forums; bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Channel, and Public Sector leadership.

 You Have

• 8+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or technology sales experience, including 3–5 years leading quota-carrying sales teams.

• A consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and developing new public-sector logos in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

• Direct SLED experience, leading a SLED sales team across multiple states and account segments.

• Strong relationships and market knowledge across the Eastern U.S. SLED landscape, with the ability to build access in state agencies, municipalities, counties, school districts, community colleges, universities, and higher-education systems.

• Working knowledge of SLED and education budget cycles, procurement, contracting, cooperative purchasing, contract vehicles, reseller models, systems-integrator motions, and partner-led delivery.

• Demonstrated success creating and progressing opportunities before an RFI/RFP, influencing requirements, building consensus, and closing new logos through customer value rather than product positioning alone.

• Experience leading executive conversations with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, chief digital officers, superintendents, higher-education technology and security leaders, procurement executives, and mission owners.

• Strong understanding of identity security, IAM, CIAM, workforce identity, authentication, authorization, federation, identity governance, fraud and verification, Zero Trust, cloud and hybrid architectures, and subscription software models.

• Ability to connect identity strategy to SLED mission outcomes, including public safety, benefits and constituent services, workforce productivity, student success, research, privacy, accessibility, and resilience.

• Familiarity with relevant public-sector and education frameworks, including CISA Zero Trust guidance, NIST Digital Identity Guidelines, CJIS, FERPA, state privacy requirements, and applicable cloud-security or accessibility requirements.

• Strong leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, inspection, and change-management skills; credible with customers, partners, and senior internal stakeholders.

• Fluency with Salesforce and related sales, forecasting, account-planning, and productivity tools; analytical and data-driven decision-making.

 Preferred:

• Experience selling or leading in identity security, cybersecurity, IAM, CIAM, fraud prevention, identity verification, or adjacent cloud-security markets.

• Experience with higher-education consortia, K–12 districts, state education agencies, or multi-campus environments.

• Established relationships with national and regional public-sector resellers, distributors, systems integrators, advisory firms, cloud providers, technology alliances, and education ecosystem partners.

• Familiarity with emerging identity requirements for AI agents, non-person identities, automated workflows, and machine-to-machine access.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; relevant identity, cybersecurity, public-sector, or sales leadership certifications are a plus.

 What Success Looks Like

• The team consistently meets or exceeds quota, new-logo, pipeline, and expansion objectives across state, local, higher-education, and K–12 segments.

• SLED East has a current, executable territory plan that links priority accounts to mission hypotheses, budget timing, procurement routes, contract vehicles, partner coverage, executive relationships, and next actions.

• New logo pipeline is created early, with measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced contributions and opportunities that are shaped before formal solicitation whenever appropriate.

• Forecasts are accurate, conservative, and explainable; every material opportunity has verified funding, decision criteria, stakeholder coverage, procurement path, competitive strategy, close plan, and timing risk.

• Customers experience one coordinated Ping team and see identity security connected to measurable mission, security, service, privacy, and resilience outcomes.

• National and regional partnerships produce stronger customer access, useful market intelligence, effective co-selling and procurement execution, and a growing pipeline of qualified new logos.

• Strategic Account Executives demonstrate disciplined account planning, discovery, qualification, value selling, stakeholder expansion, proposal leadership, negotiation, and post-award expansion planning.

• The team develops talent, shares field intelligence, uses data and AI responsibly, and operates with accountability, ethics, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

title: Manager, Technical Enablement
description:
Headquarters: Remote, New York, United States, AMER

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 As Manager, Technical Enablement, you will be the founding people leader of a dedicated technical enablement function, built to support our large and growing global Sales Engineering team. Our Sales Engineers are central to how we win, and as the team scales, it needs enablement that matches the depth of the work. You will hire, lead, and develop a team of enablement professionals, and you will serve as a player-coach, contributing directly to the programs your team delivers.

 Working in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement and global Sales Engineering leadership, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement. You will identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and build the technical onboarding, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that take our field well beyond foundational product knowledge. You will partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to turn each release into field-ready technical content, and you will measure readiness and program effectiveness so that the function earns its place as a trusted partner to the field and to leadership.

 Technologies You’ll Use

 Notion, Salesforce, Gong, Thought Industries, Claude, Sumble, Hex, Nook, Jira, Navan, Nooks, Sales Navigator, AI role play tools

 What You’ll Do

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of advanced technical enablement in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement for the global Field Engineering team

• Lead and develop a team of enablement professionals while serving as a player-coach, contributing directly to the execution of team priorities.

• Partner with global Field Engineering leadership to identify capability gaps, establish proficiency standards, and prioritize readiness programs across regions.

• Build and maintain deep technical product training, hands-on workshops, certifications, and ongoing coaching that go beyond foundational seller education.

• Define technical onboarding curriculum, ramp milestones, and proficiency benchmarks in partnership with the existing onboarding team.

• Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to translate releases and product differentiation into field-ready technical content and practical exercises.

• Collaborate with Sales and Revenue Enablement to connect seller-facing technical fluency with advanced solution discovery, demonstrations, evaluations, and technical sales processes.

• Build a structured feedback loop between field teams and Product, and measure technical readiness, training adoption, demo environment health, and program effectiveness.

• Lead cross-functional programs through influence, clear stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution in a global matrix environment.

• Monitor completion rates, assessment results, field feedback, and ramp outcomes, and use these insights to refine programs and report progress to leadership.

 Skills We’re Looking For

• 4+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, field engineering, or related technical go-to-market roles, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs or teams.

• Previous people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members

• Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms, data integration, analytics engineering, cloud data architectures, and technical evaluation practices.

• Experience designing enablement programs, such as and delivering advanced technical training, coaching, and developing on-demand learning modules

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote, India, APAC

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
 ​
 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Semantic Layer team in Bengaluru. You'll own the health, delivery, and growth of the team behind MetricFlow — building and coaching a group of engineers, setting technical direction in partnership with your leads, and ensuring one of the most important projects in the modern data stack keeps shipping with quality and momentum.

 This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend most of your time growing people, running a healthy delivery process, and shaping strategy — but you'll stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make sound technical calls and earn the trust of a senior engineering team. You'll also be the steward of a public, community-facing open-source project, balancing the needs of internal roadmap and external contributors.

 About the team

 The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow — the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications.

 This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. The team works at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution — solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business.

 What you'll do

•
 Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers building MetricFlow — hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and day-to-day support.

•
 Own delivery for the Semantic Layer team: planning, prioritization, execution, and predictable shipping of high-quality software.

•
 Partner with your senior and staff engineers to set technical direction across metric definitions, query compilation, dimensional modeling, and SQL generation for multiple data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others).

•
 Steward MetricFlow as an open-source project — set the bar for how the team triages issues, reviews external pull requests, manages releases, and engages the community on GitHub and in Slack.

•
 Collaborate with engineering leaders across the dbt platform, dbt Core, and the Semantic Layer service to ensure MetricFlow integrates seamlessly with the rest of the dbt ecosystem.

•
 Partner with product, design, and developer-relations counterparts to translate customer and community feedback into a clear, well-sequenced roadmap.

•
 Drive engineering excellence in performance, reliability, and observability of metric query execution at scale.

•
 Foster a culture of design docs, thoughtful code review, and durable engineering — shipping fast without shipping sloppy.

 Skills we're looking for

•
 Experience managing software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management, with a track record of shipping production systems.

•
 A strong engineering foundation — you've built and shipped production software yourself and can engage credibly on architecture and technical tradeoffs with a senior team.

•
 Familiarity with the technical domain: SQL fundamentals, how analytical query engines and data warehouses execute queries, and systems that involve parsing, compilation, or transformation (query planners, DSL compilers, type systems, or rule-based engines).

•
 Solid grasp of software design principles: clean APIs, modularity, testability, and backwards compatibility — and the judgment to hold a team to them.

•
 Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product managers, and external community members.

•
 Experience leading in a distributed, asynchronous team environment.

 Nice to have

•
 Experience leading or contributing to a popular open-source project, including managing a community of external contributors.

•
 Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or other semantic-layer technologies.

•
 Background in data warehousing internals, query optimization, or analytical SQL dialects.

•
 Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and release engineering for Python libraries.

•
 Exposure to building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or CLIs.

 Why join us

•
 Impact at scale: Your team's code will run inside the data platforms of tens of thousands of companies, including some of the world's largest enterprises.

•
 Open-source ownership: You'll lead the team behind a foundational open-source project — visible, reviewed, and used by the global data community.

•
 A team that values craft: We invest in design docs, code review, and durable engineering. We ship fast, but we don't ship sloppy.

•
 Competitive compensation: Market-leading salary, equity, comprehensive health insurance, generous time off, learning and wellness stipends, and home-office support.

title: Briefing Content Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote in the US

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 The Global Executive Content and Experiences team creates experiences for executive audiences that build advocacy and trust, strengthen relationships, and generate revenue. We develop content and programs that help Stripe attract, grow, and retain our most strategic users.

 What you’ll do

 As an Executive Briefing Content Strategist on the Executive Briefing team, you’ll turn account research, business insights, and Stripe’s product capabilities into tailored content for executive briefings. Your work will help executive audiences understand how Stripe can support their business objectives and create new opportunities for growth.

 You’ll partner with Executive Briefing Managers and colleagues across Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Stripe’s executive leadership to develop materials that educate and inspire existing and prospective users. Through compelling narratives and visual storytelling, you’ll help build trust in Stripe as a financial infrastructure partner.

• Partner with Stripe leaders and cross-functional teams to create and repurpose narratives and visual content that advance account relationships and build trust in Stripe

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience with visual storytelling across presentations, videos, blogs, or webpages

• Graphic design skills

• Experience managing a creative agency

title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, UK)
description:
Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote)

 Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

 The Opportunity

 About our platform

 Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

 The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

 About the Infrastructure group

 We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

 You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

 We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

 How we work

 Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

 Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

 What You'll Be Doing

• Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.

• Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.

• Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.

• Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.

• Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.

• Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.

• Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.

• Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

 We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

 We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

 What Makes You a Great Fit

• Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage

• Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.

• Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.

• A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.

• The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.

• Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.

• You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.

• Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

 Bonus Points For

• Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability

• Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.

• Building self-service infrastructure for application teams

• Running observability for a production platform at scale

• Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure

• You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

 In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £ 107,077 - £128,493 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

 #LI-Remote

 *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

 Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

 Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. title: Senior Manager, Security
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US West

 About the Job:

 We're looking for a senior security leader to run our Product Security team and partner to the Director of Security. In this role, you'll own how Security operates: a program led by risk rather than audit calendars, where engineering teams own their security health and Security informs, guides, and validates, where automation and AI take the first pass on every finding, and where posture is measured and published to executives every quarter. You'll build that model, starting with Product Security and extending across the division.

 You'll bring a balance of people management, security judgment, and program leadership as you manage a team of security engineers, act as incident manager of record, hold delegated approval for vendor and access decisions, and run the division when the Director is in an audit, a board cycle, or on vacation. You'll work closely with every engineering team to make the secure path the easy one.

 Responsibilities:

•
 Manage the portfolio of your team's work, appropriately managing everyone's time and assigning them to the highest priority work.

•
 Help your team and the engineering organization make sense of, and simplify, how security work gets done: who owns what, what is automated, and what Security stops doing.

•
 Guide product engineering teams in owning their own security health: findings route to them with mapped severity, Security reviews and validates rather than fixes, and each team sees its security health in its own service review.

•
 Own the wiring and routing of security findings and requests, driving down noise and the human-decision rate across intake, triage, and review.

•
 Serve as incident manager of record for security incidents: first escalation for our service-level commitments, delegated approver for vendor and access decisions, and cover for the Director's operational duties.

•
 Publish posture: monthly service-level attainment to engineering, quarterly posture to the executive team, and a risk register that drives priorities.

 About You:

•
 You have led a security team out of the gatekeeper model once already, and you can say what teams owned afterward, what Security stopped doing, and what the numbers did.

•
 You think in risk, not control lists, and you would rather defend a priority call than a checklist.

•
 You treat automation and AI as the first responder and yourself as the escalation path.

•
 You have been the second leader to a director or CISO and know which decisions to make in their name.

In this role, you cannot wait for the channel to bring inbound leads; you will drive the co-selling cadence, initiate joint territory campaigns, qualify high-value deals and steer deals across the finish line with our direct sales team and partner reps.

 Core Technology Focus

• Content Delivery Network (CDN) & Edge Cloud / Compute

• Application Security (Next-Gen WAF, Bot Management, API Security, DDoS Mitigation)

• Edge Observability & Performance

• Emerging Edge & AI Workloads

 What You'll Do:

• Build Active Pipeline (Co-Sell & Originate): Drive net-new pipeline creation. Lead proactive account mapping, joint prospecting, and outbound campaigns with partner sales forces rather than relying on inbound partner-delivered leads.

• Recruit & Rationalize Channel Network: Map and onboard high-performing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), National & Global System Integrators (SIs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), Managed Services Providers (MSPs) and regional distributors across India and South Asian markets. You will also onboard technology partners (ISVs and ecosystem alliances) where Fastly could natively integrate to create new routes to market. Additionally, you will oversee activating the channel partnerships led through leading Indian Telcos.

• Execute Joint Business Planning (JBP): Establish clear revenue targets, deal-registration commitments, and measurable go-to-market motions with Tier-1 partners. Align partner leadership with mutual commercial upside.

• Deal Cadence & Field Alignment: Act as the connective tissue between regional direct Account Executives (AEs) and partner sales teams. Manage multi-party deal dynamics, mitigate channel conflict, and compress enterprise sales cycles.

• Regional Market Execution: Adapt commercial engagement and distribution channels to suit local cross-border dynamics, procurement nuances, and distributor models in Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal alongside high-scale operations in India.

• Operational Rigor: Take end-to-end accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, quarterly forecasting, deal registrations, and CRM data integrity across the region.

 What We're Looking For:

• Sales-Led Ecosystem Mindset: 8+ years of quota-carrying channel sales or partner management experience within enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, CDN, or cybersecurity, with a verifiable track record of beating pipeline and revenue goals.

• Active Co-Selling Instincts: Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch. You know how to motivate partner field reps, run outbound cadences together, and lead high-stakes enterprise deals to closure.

• South Asia Market Depth: Deep existing relationships with key regional distributors, tier-one IT security VARs, and leading System Integrators across India, with hands-on experience navigating business practices in South Asian emerging markets.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: High conversational fluency in web application architecture, cloud networking, cyber threat vectors, and API security. You can hold your own with Partner CTOs, CISOs, and enterprise architects before handing over to technical specialists.

• Autonomy & Bias for Action: Comfort operating in a fast-evolving regional territory with minimal supervision. You run your region as your own franchise, proactively removing blockers to generate revenue.

• Established relationships and prior commercial wins with tier-1 Indian telco enterprise divisions

• Proven track record onboarding and monetizing regional two-tier distribution networks across emerging South Asian markets (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nepal)

• Hands-on experience structuring bundled managed service offerings with top MSSP SOC teams, embedding edge security and WAF into continuous service contracts

• Prior background executing cloud marketplace transacting models (AWS, GCP, Azure) and co-selling alongside cloud hyper-scalers

• Deep exposure to regional BFSI, high-traffic media/OTT, or hyper-scale e-commerce architectures and procurement frameworks in South Asia

• Experience operationalizing technology integrations and joint GTM motions with leading cybersecurity ISVs, APM platforms, or CI/CD ecosystems

• Technical background or foundational certifications in cloud networking, web performance, or application security frameworks

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are seeking a Security Solutions Engineer with a strong background in strategic solution evaluation, vendor assessment, and hands-on Proof-of-Concept (PoC) validation. This role is a crucial bridge between identifying customer security requirements and implementing best-in-class, enterprise-grade solutions. You will be responsible for defining the criteria, researching the market, and executing technical validation for all major security tooling and services adopted by the company.

Key responsibilities:

1. Strategic Research & Requirement Definition

  • Threat-to-Solution Mapping: Proactively analyze customer expectations, regulatory/compliance drivers, and threat models to define precise functional and non-functional requirements for new security solutions.
  • Market Analysis & Scouting: Conduct thorough market scans to identify cutting-edge security products, platforms, and vendors across key domains (e.g., CSPM/CNAPP, DLP, IAM/IGA, EDR/XDR, data security, Kubernetes security, and AI/ML security).
  • Vendor Due Diligence: Evaluate potential vendors based on technical capability, security posture, integration requirements, roadmap, data residency/compliance, and support quality, and shortlist candidates for the PoC phase.

2. Technical Validation & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Leadership

  • PoC Planning & Design: Develop detailed, objective, and threat-aligned test plans and success criteria for all security solution Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs), including quantitative success metrics, coverage of key attack scenarios, and opportunities for automation.
  • Hands-on Environment Setup: Independently architect and deploy isolated PoC environments that accurately simulate our production infrastructure (e.g., setting up cloud VPCs, Kubernetes clusters, integrating with test data via IaC, and mimicking typical workloads).
  • Testing & Analysis: Execute security research methodologies within the PoC (e.g., simulating attack scenarios, conducting deep feature validation, assessing false positive/negative rates) to rigorously test the vendor solution's effectiveness.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Southern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and GP growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.
  • Growing our revenue and gross profit share of wallet within your key account list.
  • Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.
  • Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.
  • Selling solutions to a technical and business audience.
  • Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in both English and Hebrew
  • 6+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base.
  • History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to SMB.
  • Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.

Desired:

  • Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable. Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice Calling, Email, Account Security Verification. Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.

Location

The position will be based in the United Kingdom, Spain or Ireland

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Europe
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who combines strong Playwright and TypeScript engineering skills with a proactive, collaborative mindset. You'll be a key contributor to how we deliver quality, raising the bar for our automation codebase and partnering closely with engineering to define how testing responsibility is shared across the team.

 You’ll join our dynamic and growing Product Engineering team at Storyblok, playing an instrumental role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our flagship CMS platform. This platform empowers businesses to create and deliver seamless digital content experiences.

 In this role, you'll work closely with product owners, designers, and developers to design and maintain clean, scalable, well-architected TypeScript automation, establish clear guidelines on which test level is right for a given change, and continuously refine QA strategies to maintain best-in-class software quality. Your work will directly contribute to delivering an exceptional user experience by ensuring flawless performance across every facet of our application.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Own projects end-to-end with clarity, technical excellence, and accountability, ensuring high-quality standards across teams.

• Champion strong TypeScript engineering practices and coding standards across the QA codebase, promoting engineering excellence and driving continuous improvement.

• Design, implement, and maintain efficient, well-typed, and reliable automated tests across frontend and backend using Playwright.

• Raise the team's TypeScript bar: introduce stronger typing patterns, reusable abstractions, linting/tooling standards, and code review practices that improve maintainability across the automation codebase.

• Partner with engineering to define, implement, and enforce the test pyramid in practice, establishing clear guidelines on which test level (unit, integration, E2E) is appropriate for a given change, and driving adoption so both developers and QAs consistently write tests at the right level.

• Perform manual and exploratory testing; document, track, and verify defects to ensure product excellence and analyze test results and monitor key testing metrics to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement.

• Participate actively in project kick-offs to understand requirements, anticipate risks, and influence testability from the earliest stages.

• Identify and communicate issues, risks, or dependencies early, escalating to product leadership when necessary.

• Mentor and support teammates on TypeScript proficiency and Playwright best practices, fostering an open, empathetic environment that encourages learning and feedback.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• 7+ years of relevant experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test.

• Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including a strong command of advanced typing and code architecture, as well as Playwright.

• Practical experience partnering with engineers to define and roll out test pyramid guidelines, including setting expectations for which test level is appropriate and holding both developers and QAs accountable for following them.

• Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and experience creating and maintaining containerized test environments.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align across technical and product teams.

• High attention to detail, proven ability to deliver results, and a strong motivation to contribute to organizational growth in a high-performing environment.

• Experience mentoring engineers, defining and driving TypeScript and test automation standards across teams.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 NICE TO HAVE

• Experience writing and maintaining Ruby on Rails code.

• Experience with observability and error tracking tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Sentry) and identifying errors, trends, and issues.

• Experience with performance testing and best practices.

We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.

 Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.

 Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.

 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

 Key responsibilities:

• Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it

• Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending

• Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate

• Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better

• Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality

• Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves

• Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them

• Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

 Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

• A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
