title: Head of Product - Business Banking
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.

 A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market.

 Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.

 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

 Key responsibilities:

• Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents

• Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives

• Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives pace and quality

• Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building their companies

• Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them

• Align the banking ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

 Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

• A leader with great product chops, commercial instinct to grow the business, and discipline to run it safely

• A high bar for craft – leading a creative, customer-centered, data-driven and experimentation-oriented approach

• Enthusiasm for building AI- and agent-powered products that drive spectacular customer experiences

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, risk, compliance, finance, and partners

• 10+ years' experience, ideally in banking, payments, platforms, or financial products

• 5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management

• Experience launching and scaling 0-1 financial products, ideally in fintech or another high-growth environment, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good?

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position:

  • You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty
  • You will work independently, with few constraints
  • You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs:

  1. There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own
  2. Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)
  3. We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are:

  • We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles.

This role is right for you if:

  • You care about our mission
  • You agree with our values
  • You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here).
  • You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.
  • You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year
  • You are fluent in English
  • You have 4+ years of engineering experience
  • You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.
  • You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.
  • You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).
  • You are happy and skilled at working directly with non-engineers on messy, poorly defined, rapidly changing, sometimes boring tasks

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$27,170, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$31,789 in 2025)

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

title: Presales Engineer
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

About the job

The Twilio Presales Engineer is both highly technical and a skilled executive relationship builder. They are comfortable showing an engaging communications experience to a CEO or sketching out a flow on a whiteboard with technical decision makers.

This position is needed to deliver the technical win and product fit to our customers across the EMEA region. A Twilio Presales Engineer is an experienced pre-sales engineer who builds customer trust in Twilio’s Customer Engagement Platform, resulting in customer success at our largest, most strategic accounts. The Presales Engineer leads the technical pre-sales relationship, proposes technical architectures, demonstrates the product, anticipates concerns, and provides creative solutions to our customers' most complex communications and customer engagement challenges and needs.

Responsibilities

In this role as Presales Engineer, you’ll:

  • Work alongside Twilio New business Account Executives, other Twilio Solutions Engineers, Professional Services and Twilio Partners as needed through the pre-sales process, to strategise and plan for deal success.
  • Build a successful business partnership with Twilio Account Executives focussing on great business discovery within prospects and communicating the business value of Twilio solutions.
  • Take part alongside Account Executives in qualification, discovery, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concept, RFP response, design documentation, technical presentations and enablement sessions during the sales cycle.
  • Develop subject matter expertise on the customer needs and requirements, and Twilio’s best in class communications technology.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with our customers to uncover their needs and challenges to articulate Twilio’s ability to enable their success and solve their challenges.
  • Build and present powerful and complex presentations and product demos to help showcase the capabilities of Twilio Communications Products.
  • Form an understanding of a customers business and help solve problems they’ve identified as well as uncover areas of opportunity.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships at the highest levels of our customers and present creative new solutions and architectures that enable and inspire innovation
  • Contribute to the wider Twilio Solutions Engineer community by sharing knowledge, building demo assets and reusable presentations.

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Twilio is looking for a Presales Engineer with a strong desire to work in a technical pre-sales role. You will need:

Required:

  • At least 3 years in a technical pre-sales role in CPaaS, SaaS or Telecom space
  • Solid understanding and experience of the sales cycle and the role of a pre-sales engineer
  • Solid understanding of voice protocols (VoIP), SIP implementations or messaging APIs
  • Creativity: you’ll need to be a problem solver, able to collaborate with others to drive success.
  • An engaging storyteller: you can gain audience confidence and communicate complex topics to multiple levels of technical and non-technical audience.
  • Ability to ask the right questions to build a deep understanding of a customers needs and guide them to a technical solution using Twilio Communications products
  • Knowledge of public cloud platforms (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and cloud application architectures
  • Experience writing code in one or more of the following areas, multiple areas of experience would be advantageous:
    • Backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python or PHP)
    • Web (JS, React)
    • Experience with designing and consuming REST APIs

Desired:

  • Hands on experience with with backend development (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc)
  • Familiarity with Mobile development, especially for iOS and Android.
  • Previous experience in Telecommunications, SIP, WebRTC, or Contact Centre in a technical role
  • Experience with automation, cloud-native development and skills with a major cloud platform.
  • Experience with sales methodologies

Location

This role will be remotely based in the UK or Ireland

We prioritise connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 35% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

The AI revolution is here, and enterprises are racing to adopt GenAI - but they cannot deploy what they cannot secure. Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security.

In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection. As our premier technical authority, you will partner with Fortune 500 executives and architects, serving as a trusted advisor to help them confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure. If you are a builder, an educator, and a master storyteller who thrives in a fast-evolving market, this is your chance to lead the industry's most critical conversation.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close.
  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler’s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives. When needed, take customers through successful demos and POVs to validate Zscaler’s ability to securely enable enterprise AI.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage.
  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force.
  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler’s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical challenges. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and are always looking for a better, more secure, and scalable way.

What We’re Looking For

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them.
  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles.
  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations.
  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes.
  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.
  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications.
  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage.
  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win.

About You

  • Qualifications: Level 3 Hairdressing/Barbering qualification, Assessor Award (e.g., CAVA, TAQA, A1), and Level 2 English & Maths (IQA or teaching qualification desirable).

  • Industry & Assessment Experience: Proven background in current salon practices, carrying out workplace assessments, and managing learner portfolios.

  • Teaching & Autonomy: Ability to plan and deliver practical/theoretical training independently with minimal supervision.

title: Senior People Operations Manager
description:
About Us

City of London Academies Trust believes strongly in the transformational nature of education operating schools in areas of significant disadvantage. We understand that strong outcomes lead to improved life chances for our students, so we are unashamedly academic and unapologetically results driven. Each of our schools adopt a ‘warm/strict’ approach, combining high expectations with care and support. Our level of care means we never compromise on standards or expectations, ensuring that no student’s background becomes a reason for lowering the bar. Our schools maintain exemplary standards of behaviour, with systems, rituals and norms that instil strong habits. As a result, our schools provide an environment where our teachers can teach, and students can learn without disruption. We take great pride in fostering an exceptionally positive learning environment and we work meticulously to maintain our strong ethos and culture.

COLAT is driven by an unwavering ambition to be the best. We believe exceptional leaders and teachers create outstanding schools, transforming lives and shaping the future of every student. We currently oversee seven secondary academies, three primary academies and one sixth form centre all located in north, south and east London. We combine the heritage and tradition of the Corporation of London with a genuinely innovative, enterprising, and entrepreneurial ethos. We are also committed to providing training and development to all our staff, plus excellent career advancement opportunities within our evolving Trust.

About you

Dynamic, experienced and focused on improvement, you will bring strong leadership and a commitment to delivering high quality people services. Working closely with the HR Director, you will play a key role in shaping and strengthening people operations across the Trust, ensuring that services are efficient, accurate, responsive and focused on the needs of our academies and employees.

You will bring significant experience of leading HR or people operations within a complex organisation, with the confidence and technical knowledge to oversee payroll, employee lifecycle processes, HR systems and workforce data. You will be comfortable leading change, improving processes and using technology to create simpler and more effective ways of working.

As an effective leader and communicator, you will build strong relationships, constructively challenge established practice and bring the sound judgement and attention to detail needed to manage risk and maintain high standards of compliance. You will be resilient, collaborative and able to balance strategic improvement with the demands of effective day to day service delivery.

About the Role

The Senior People Operations Manager plays a key role within the Trust’s People operating model, providing leadership and oversight of people operations across the organisation. Working closely with the HR Director and wider People Team, the postholder will ensure that core people services are efficient, accurate, compliant and responsive to the needs of academies, employees and leaders.

The role leads the delivery and continuous improvement of people operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contractual administration, payroll, HR systems, employee records and workforce data. A key focus will be improving processes, strengthening controls and making effective use of systems, technology and automation to create simpler and more consistent ways of working across the Trust.

The Senior People Operations Manager will lead and develop the operational team, working collaboratively with academy and central colleagues to maintain high standards of service delivery. The role also provides senior oversight of key compliance responsibilities, including right to work requirements and the effective management of the Trust’s UKVI sponsor licence.

Using data, insight and professional expertise, the postholder will support effective decision making and ensure that people operations continue to develop in response to the Trust’s strategic and operational needs.

How to Apply

If you share our ambition and would like to join our dedicated team of professionals, we would be pleased to hear from you. Candidates must address the person specification in no more than 1,000 words. Applications must be submitted via the MyNewTerm portal.

Your application should include full contact details and the names and contact details of two referees. One referee must be your current or most recent employer. If you do not wish us to contact your referees at this stage, please make this clear in your application.

For further information or an informal discussion about the role, please contact Katyryna Zamulinskyj, Director of HR, at Katyryna.zamulinskyj@cityoflondon.gov.uk

Selection Timeline

Closing date : 9:00am Wednesday 9 December 2026.

Selection activities and interviews: Monday 14 December 20256

We are not using recruitment agencies for this appointment and kindly ask agencies not to make contact.

City of London Academies Trust supports equality of opportunity in employment.

City of London Academies Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. We expect all employees to share this commitment and to undergo appropriate checks in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education. This includes an enhanced DBS check and a willingness to demonstrate commitment to the standards arising from the Trust’s vision and values.

This role is covered by Part 7 of the Immigration Act 2016. The ability to speak fluent English is therefore an essential requirement.

Set up and chair School Attendance Meetings with parents of persistently absent pupils and schedule follow-up review meetings to be held a month later

Support the delivery of safeguarding briefings and updates to staff

Support pupils that are anxious or school refusers and coordinate support to reintegrate back into education.

Train the Receptionist and Admin Assistant in attendance recording systems

title: Head of Specialist Resource Provision (ASC)
description:
This is a rare opportunity to shape a specialist provision from its inception, creating a centre of excellence that enables young people with autism to thrive both within the provision and as part of our wider school community. Working in partnership with Surrey County Council, the successful candidate will lead a provision that will grow from an initial cohort of five students to a capacity of twenty-five places.

The SRP will act as a base for students, who will broadly spend half of their time in the mainstream school, and half within the base itself.

We are looking for an ambitious and highly skilled practitioner with expertise in autism education and the leadership qualities required to establish a brand-new provision. The successful candidate will lead the development of curriculum, systems, staffing and practice, while teaching within the provision, developing specialist staff, working closely with families and external agencies, and supporting students to access both specialist and mainstream learning opportunities. The postholder will work closely with the SENCO and report directly to the Headteacher.

This role is perfect for an ambitious SEND leader seeking the opportunity to establish and lead a new specialist provision, or for an experienced SENCO, specialist provision leader or autism specialist looking for a unique and rewarding challenge.

Please contact us for a tour and to find out more.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead the establishment and development of the ASC Resource Provision from inception.
  • Develop the vision, values and strategic direction of the provision.
  • Create systems, policies and operational procedures required for successful implementation.
  • Develop a phased growth plan as student numbers increase.
  • Ensure the provision reflects current best practice in autism education.
  • Contribute to wider school inclusion and SEND strategy.

Curriculum Development

  • Design and implement an appropriately ambitious curriculum for students within the provision.
  • Develop personalised pathways which support academic, social, emotional and independence outcomes.
  • Ensure effective integration between specialist and mainstream learning experiences.

Teaching and Learning

  • Teach students within the provision.
  • Model exemplary autism practice.
  • Support mainstream staff to adapt teaching and learning effectively.
  • Monitor student progress and evaluate provision impact.
  • Ensure students achieve ambitious academic and personal outcomes.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Essential

  • Qualified Teacher Status.
  • Successful experience working with students with Autism Spectrum Condition.
  • Significant SEND leadership experience.
  • Experience of curriculum design and implementation.
  • Experience managing staff.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • SEND Code of Practice
  • EHCP processes
  • Autism-specific interventions
  • Inclusion and mainstream access arrangements
  • Strong communication and partnership working skills.

Desirable

  • National Award for SEN Coordination (or working towards).
  • Experience leading a specialist resource provision or autism base.
  • Experience in a special school or specialist setting.
  • Experience establishing new provision or leading significant change.
  • Qualification in Autism Education or SEND Leadership.

Please see attached job pack for full job specification.

title: Senior Customer Engineer - LATAM (Spanish Speaking)
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US (Remote)

 About Mixpanel

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

 About the Customer Engineering Team

 Mixpanel's Customer Engineering teams are analytics consultants who embed themselves within our enterprise customer teams to drive business outcomes. We work with prospects and customers throughout the customer journey to understand what drives value, and serve as the technical counterpart to our Sales organisation to deliver on that value.

 You will partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Value Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support to successfully roll out self-serve analytics within our customers' organisations, help manage change, execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers, and ultimately drive ROI on the customer's Mixpanel investment.

 About the Role

 Our Customer Engineers are inquisitive, nimble, and able to clearly articulate the technical benefits and requirements of Mixpanel to developers and product managers, while also communicating the business value of our product to senior executives.

 In your first month, you'll become a Mixpanel expert—both in features and functionality as well as implementation. You'll shadow customer calls and demos with current Customer Engineers and Account Executives while learning to articulate our value proposition, and be trained on Mixpanel's internal systems and tools.

 Within your first three months, you'll be directly involved in deal cycles with Account Executives. You'll lead the technical qualification for customer use cases and deliver customised demos for prospects and existing customers, working directly with leadership at the prospect's organisation to understand business challenges that can be solved through an analytics platform.

 You'll also work with the prospect's business and technical teams to scope and execute proof-of-concept projects to establish Mixpanel's value—including consulting on data ingestion methods, overall architecture, success criteria, and rollout strategies for analytics tools across an organisation.

 Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor for prospects, providing strategic consultation on data architecture, governance, instrumentation, and business outcomes

• Communicate and consult effectively at all levels of the customer's organisation to earn trust and influence buying decisions

• Bridge the technical-business gap—working with senior stakeholders to define success for proofs-of-concept and ensuring successful execution and outcomes

• Leverage your Mixpanel expertise and technical/consultative skills to impart best practices throughout proof-of-concept projects

• Partner with Account Executives to drive revenue growth, serving as the key technical contact for customers

• Partner with post-sales teams to ensure that pre-sales value propositions translate into tangible post-sales results

• Develop relationships and uncover the needs of key technical stakeholders within your assigned book of business

• Be the "Voice of the Prospect" by collecting feedback from potential Mixpanel customers and sharing it with the Product team

 We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• Fluency in business and conversational Spanish and English.

• The ability to communicate with stakeholders at all levels—from discussing APIs with developers to organisational efficiency with CIOs.

• A demonstrated track record of qualifying and selling technical solutions to executive stakeholders

• 6+ years of experience in a Software-as-a-Service Sales Engineering or related role

• Experience in data querying, modelling, and transformation using tools such as SQL, dbt, Python, Business Intelligence platforms, or Product Analytics tools

• Familiarity with databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks)

• A successful record of experience in sales engineering, consulting, or technical project management

• Excellent written, analytical, communication, and presentation skills

• Strong process and project delivery discipline

• Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini

• The ability to travel as needed

 Bonus Points For

• Experience with value engineering frameworks: translating customer pain into quantified business outcomes, building ROI calculators, and leading executive-level value conversations tied to measurable KPIs

• Exposure to product-led growth (PLG) environments and sales-assisted conversion motions

• Background in high-growth SaaS environments (Series B–E or beyond)

title: Machine Learning Engineer II, Responsible AI
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US

 About Pinterest:

 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

 The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.

 At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.

 Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone , hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type .

 You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.

 What you'll do:

• execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.

• Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.

• Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.

• Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.

 What we're looking for:

• Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.

• Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.

• Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.

• 2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products

• Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields

• Nice to have:

• Publications at top ML conferences

• Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring

• Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration

• Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data

• Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

 Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

 In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter, and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

  • Service – a commitment to improving opportunities for, and bettering the lives of others in, our community

Why Join Us?

At Colyton Grammar School, you’ll be a valuable member of a committed team with access to chances for professional growth and the opportunity to play a significant role in learners’ academic advancements.

  • Streamlined Processes: We’ve removed written reports and formal observations, so you can focus on teaching.
  • Balanced Work-Life Schedule: After-school meetings and parents' evenings are only held on Thursdays, and there are no heavy marking expectations, checking of lesson plans, or book scrutinies. We trust our staff to deliver the best for our students.
  • Collaborative Planning Made Easy: Teams and OneNote make collaborative planning much easier, ensuring that you’re never working alone.
  • PPA is protected, and can be spent at home.
  • Extra Time for Curriculum Planning: Departments are supported with additional cover for curriculum planning time when needed.
  • Flexibility: Staff are free to leave the site when not teaching, and we cover staff for personal or medical appointments, so you don’t have to worry about scheduling conflicts.
  • Exam Board Marking During School Hours: Exam board marking can be completed during the school day where gained time allows, and any gained time can be spent at home.
  • Professional Development: We offer 2 INSET days at the start of the academic year and 2 at the end of an extended October half-term, during which you’ll have the opportunity to visit other schools, gain new ideas, and establish partnerships.
  • CPD Pathways: Rather than data-driven performance management targets, we allow staff to choose a CPD Pathway that best suits their personal development goals, including participation in NPQs.

Thank you for your interest in working with us!

title: Engineering Manager, Ads Product Catalogs
description:
Headquarters: Remote - The Netherlands

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.

 Reddit is where people come to discover, research, and discuss products that inform their purchasing decisions. Shopping, across advertising and organic experiences, is a high priority for the company, and product catalogs are foundational to that work.

 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Reddit’s Product Catalogs team. You will lead a full-stack engineering team responsible for the infrastructure and advertiser-facing experiences that help thousands of advertisers onboard, organize, and manage millions of products. Your team will build intuitive UIs, robust APIs, and scalable backend systems for catalog ingestion, storage, and product data management.

 These systems power Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) and organic shopping, connecting users with relevant products in the context of their interests and conversations. Someone browsing r/golf might discover popular golf clubs, while someone reading a discussion about sunglasses in r/BuyItForLife might see the exact models being discussed. Your team will make it easier for advertisers to bring their products to Reddit and participate in these moments of discovery.

 In this role, you will set technical direction, develop engineers, and drive execution across the catalog platform and advertiser experience. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to understand customer needs and make catalog onboarding and management seamless. You will also partner with Reddit’s Knowledge Graph teams to support organic shopping experiences.

 This role calls for strong technical judgment, people leadership, and a focus on customer needs. It is based in Reddit’s Amsterdam or London office, with a team working across European time zones.

 Responsibilities:

• Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products

• Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences

• Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads

• Establish and manage to SLAs within your team

• Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team

• Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

 Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development

• 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams

• You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.

• Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.

• Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

 Benefits:

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Private Pension plan with Employer-matching

• 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan

• Income Replacement Programs

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

 In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

 During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors .

 Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
description:
Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth.
The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth.
This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

 Nice to have

• Familiarity with API security

The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

title: Quantum Research Scientist
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://www.MANTECH.com

 Description & Requirements

Elevate your career with MANTECH International Corporation! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 1968, MANTECH has led in delivering advanced solutions to government intelligence, the Department of Defense, and Federal Civilian sectors. Dive into innovation in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—be extraordinary at MANTECH!

 ***This is for a future opportunity***

 MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Quantum Research Scientist to join our team in a remote role.
 The Quantum Research Scientist will advance quantum information science and optical quantum systems, leveraging expertise in continuous-variable photonics and theoretical algorithm discovery to translate complex physical phenomena into experimental prototypes and publishable research.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 • Conducting foundational and applied research to advance quantum information science, with a specialized focus on continuous-variable (CV) photonic quantum computing.
• Leading theoretical algorithm discovery, establishing novel qubit modalities, and engineering advanced error-correction schemes tailored for optical and photonic quantum systems.
• Prioritizing experimental physics integration within photonics modalities over alternative architectures.
• Translating complex mathematical models and quantum physical phenomena into experimental prototypes, technical specifications, and publishable findings.
• Collaborating closely with academic partners and cross-functional engineering teams to map cross-platform control policies to alternative modalities.
• Documenting research progress and disseminating findings through technical papers, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.

 Minimum Qualifications:
 • Master’s degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
• 4+ years of professional experience working in quantum computing or quantum information science.
• Demonstrated foundational research experience in theoretical algorithm discovery, novel qubit modalities, quantum error-correction schemes, or experimental quantum physics.
• Demonstrated experience translating complex mathematical models and physical phenomena into experimental prototypes or technical specifications.
• Ability to travel up to 25% within the Continental U.S.

 Preferred Qualifications:
 • PhD in Quantum Physics, Atomic Physics, Condensed Matter, or Computer Science with a Quantum Information Science focus.
• A robust peer-review record, industry recognition, patents, or publications in top-tier journals (e.g., Nature, PRX, IEEE).
• Professional certifications such as IBM Certified Quantum Computation using Qiskit Developer, MIT xPro Quantum Computing Fundamentals, or Advanced HPC/GPU Acceleration (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA).
• Experience applying machine learning and AI algorithms to quantum control or complex physical simulations.

 Clearance Requirements: Must be a US Citizen.

 Physical Requirements: Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. Must be able to communicate, converse, and exchange information with peers and senior personnel. Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery.

The projected compensation range for this position is $94,800.00-$157,200.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

 MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at careers@mantech.com and provide your name and contact information.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

 Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

 Role Overview

 Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

 This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

 As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

 Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

• Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

• Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

• Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

• Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

• Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

• Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

 Data & AI Infrastructure

• Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

• Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

• Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

• Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

• Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

• Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

• Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

 GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

• You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

• You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

• Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

 Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

• Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

• Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

• Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

• Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

 Who You Are

• Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

• Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

• System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

• Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

• Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

• Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

• Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

 Must-Have Skills & Experience

• 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

• Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

• Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

• Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

• Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

• Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

• Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

• Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

• Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

• Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

 Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

• Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

• Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

 Why Join Us?

• Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

• Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

• Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

• Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

• Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

 Jumio Values:

 IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

 Equal Opportunities :

 Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

 Applicant Data Privacy

 We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect

title: HR Enablement Lead
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: HR Enablement Lead

 Job Location: United States, Remote

 This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

 ABOUT THE COMPANY:

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY:

 At Salesloft, as our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.

 You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Own program lifecycles. Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.

• Create and lead workshops. Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.

• Partner with People Business Partners. Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.

• Ramp front-line managers. Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.

• Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.

• Enable the People team. Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.

• Shape the learning architecture. Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.

• Innovate with AI. Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.

• Drive business execution. Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.

• Run the learning platform. Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.

• Analyze and interpret. Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.

 THE SKILL SET:

• 5+ years of combined experience in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.

• Workshop facilitation: Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).

• Manager and onboarding programs: Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.

• Instructional innovation: Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.

• Strategic partnership: Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• AI and technical aptitude: Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.

• Systems thinking: Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.

• Program ownership: Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.

• Hands-on execution: A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.

• Communication and influence: Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.

• Instructional design: Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.

• Measurement: Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.

 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!
